relationships.subject: ruscogenin
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 strongly interacted with RUS, and TLR4 overexpression abolished the effects of RUS on anxiety and neuroinflammation.

relationships.subject: ruscogenin
relationships.evidence_quote: RUS (10 mg/kg in vivo and 1 μM in vitro) alleviated these alterations through NF-κB/MAPKs/NLRP3 signaling pathways but had no effect on pain hypersensitivity.

key_findings: Ruscogenin alleviated CFA-induced anxiety-like behavior and microglial neuroinflammation but not pain hypersensitivity.
TLR4 interacts with ruscogenin and TLR4 overexpression abolished its anxiolytic and anti-inflammatory effects.
